messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: Production inference runtime 5xx spike in us-west-2 (model-runner pool 'a'). Alert groups: gateway-5xx-rate, inference-timeouts. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/inf/overview

sam_y: ack — oncall here. pulling logs and checking node states.

taylor: i'm online. if we need to shift capacity say so.

sam_y: quick summary so far — 5xxs started ~2026-03-15T01:05Z. Correlates with repeated restarts on model-runner-gpu-11.*. Seeing kernel segfaults and OOM-ish behavior. grabbing sample logs now.

jamal_ops: can we route traffic off pool 'a' to fallback pool 'b'? autoscaler shows ~30% spare but model variants differ.

sam_y: yes starting gradual reroute to fallback-model-v1 (smaller context). Doing 10% -> 30% -> 70% if stable. Command issued: `rb route update --from pool:a --to pool:b --weight 0.1 --unsafe`

taylor: heads up fallback will truncate long contexts; some customers with long prompts may see shorter outputs. support should be notified.

sam_y: paste of suspicious log lines (truncated):
```
[01:06:42 UTC] model-runner-gpu-11 kernel: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8a3b2e3fff sp 0x7ffdaff8f0 -- SIGSEGV
[01:06:42 UTC] model-runner-gpu-11 runtime: fatal error: double free or corruption (fasttop)
[01:06:42 UTC] inference: killing process pid=48321 due to OOM
[01:06:43 UTC] orchestrator: restart model-runner-gpu-11 (reason: exit(139))
```

marta_k: i'm drafting the customer notice. which accounts are likely affected?

eve_support: top impacted orgs by error volume: AcmeCorp (12% of total errors), BrightHealth (9%), NoteNote (6%). Preparing targeted messages.

sam_y: root cause hypothesis: a kernel-level quantization optimization (quant-kernel-v2) rolled forward at ~00:58Z to pool 'a'. rollout history: `infra rollout show --group us-west-2-runners` shows quant-kernel-v2 applied to pool 'a' at 00:58. memory pressure + new kernel path causing CVM memory corruption on specific GPU driver/kernel combo.

jamal_ops: start rollback of quant-kernel-v2 on canary nodes. `infra rollback kernel-quant-v2 --group=us-west-2-runners --canary=3`

sam_y: also disabling continuous batching for the affected model; config change: `model-config set recommend_v2 batching: false --env=prod` to lower peak memory usage while we stabilize.

taylor: sharing live metrics: after initial 10% reroute and canary rollback, error rate on canary dropped from 16% -> 5% within 6m. Looks promising.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started: infra-job-92421; targets: us-west-2-runner-canary-1..3. ETA 4m.

sam_y: collecting core dumps and heap profiles, uploading to incidents S3: `s3://redwood-incidents/5260001234/` — will attach traces to postmortem.

marta_k: support draft ready: "We observed elevated error rates impacting a subset of model inference requests in us-west-2. Mitigation is in progress and some traffic has been routed to a fallback model. We will follow up once stability is confirmed." Approve?

eve_support: approve. also schedule an update in 30m to affected customers.

sam_y: canary rollback successful on 3 nodes; expanding rollback cluster-wide now. initiating `infra rollback kernel-quant-v2 --group=us-west-2-runners --confirm`

jamal_ops: disabling canary auto-promote for kernel rollouts until memory-profile gate exists.

sam_y: status update: rolling update finished at 01:45Z. overall 5xx rate back to ~0.9% from peak ~18%. Gateway timeouts decreasing. No persistent data loss; majority of failed requests were retried successfully by client or gateway.

incident-bot: Update: Pager auto-close threshold reached — 5xx rate below alert threshold for 15m.

marta_k: customer notices sent to AcmeCorp/BrightHealth/NoteNote. Included workaround note: use smaller prompt length or route to fallback model until 02:00Z.

amy_eng: i'll take formal handoff at 08:00 PT for deeper investigation and postmortem follow-up. leaving note: run memprof across model-runner fleet and correlate driver/kernel versions. cc @taylor

sam_y: handoff items for amy_eng: logs + core dumps in s3://redwood-incidents/5260001234/, rollback timeline, affected node list, and runbook link: https://internal/redwood/playbooks/runtime-oom.md. Also recommend adding automated canary gate on memory-profile and a preflight for quant-kernel changes.

jamal_ops: immediate action items taken: 1) rollback quant-kernel-v2, 2) disable continuous batching for recommend_v2, 3) throttle rollout automation for kernel changes, 4) upload artifacts to S3, 5) notify customers.

eve_support: created status page update and sent targeted emails.

taylor: follow-up engineering tasks: reproduce crash under mem-pressure with quant-kernel-v2 in staging, add mem-profile test to CI, add node-level OOM inspector.

sam_y: final summary for incident channel: cause likely interaction between quant-kernel-v2 code path and GPU driver combo causing memory corruption leading to OOM/segfaults -> restarts -> elevated 5xx. Mitigation: rollback + routing to fallback + disable batching. Impact: transient elevated errors (~18% peak) for ~40 minutes, affecting a handful of customers, no data loss. Postmortem scheduled.

amy_eng: thanks team — I'll own the follow-up and runbook updates. leaving handoff note in oncall log.

deploy-bot: Rollback job infra-job-92421 completed successfully at 01:44:59Z.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for active mitigation; please file postmortem and link here when ready.
